name: Claude Code

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    types: [opened, assigned]
  pull_request_review:
    types: [submitted]

jobs:
  claude:
    if: |
      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && contains(github.event.comment.body, '@claude')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request_review_comment' && contains(github.event.comment.body, '@claude')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request_review' && contains(github.event.review.body, '@claude')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' && (contains(github.event.issue.body, '@claude') || contains(github.event.issue.title, '@claude')))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read
      id-token: write
      actions: read # Required for Claude to read CI results on PRs
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Run Claude Code
        id: claude
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}

          # This is an optional setting that allows Claude to read CI results on PRs
          additional_permissions: |
            actions: read

          # Optional: Give a custom prompt to Claude. If this is not specified, Claude will perform the instructions specified in the comment that tagged it.
          # prompt: 'Update the pull request description to include a summary of changes.'

          # Optional: Add claude_args to customize behavior and configuration
          # See https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/usage.md
          # or https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference for available options
          # claude_args: '--allowed-tools Bash(gh pr *)'
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, ready_for_review, reopened]
    # Optional: Only run on specific file changes
    # paths:
    #   - "src/**/*.ts"
    #   - "src/**/*.tsx"
    #   - "src/**/*.js"
    #   - "src/**/*.jsx"

jobs:
  claude-review:
    # Optional: Filter by PR author
    # if: |
    #   github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'external-contributor' ||
    #   github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'new-developer' ||
    #   github.event.pull_request.author_association == 'FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read
      id-token: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Run Claude Code Review
        id: claude-review
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          plugin_marketplaces: 'https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code.git'
          plugins: 'code-review@claude-code-plugins'
          prompt: '/code-review:code-review --comment ${{ github.repository }}/pull/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}'
          claude_args: '--allowedTools "mcp__github_inline_comment__create_inline_comment"'
          # See https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/usage.md

name: 'Install Dependencies'
description: 'Restores node_modules from the Actions cache, or runs npm ci once and saves it'
inputs:
  browser:
    description: 'install browser and playwright dependencies'
    required: false
    default: 'false'

runs:
  using: composite

  steps:
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
      with:
        node-version-file: '.nvmrc'

    # The whole node_modules tree is cached, keyed on everything that shapes it:
    # the manifest, the lockfile, the npm config and the Node version (package.json
    # is in the key so that a manifest edit without a lockfile update still runs
    # npm ci, which rejects the mismatch). An exact hit restores the
    # finished install (including node_modules/.bin), so npm ci is skipped; there
    # are no restore-keys on purpose, because npm ci wipes node_modules anyway and
    # a stale tree would only cost the download. (An earlier attempt skipped
    # npm ci on setup-node's cache-hit, which only means ~/.npm was restored, not
    # node_modules - that is why nx was missing back then.)
    - name: Restore node_modules
      id: node-modules
      uses: actions/cache/restore@v6
      with:
        path: node_modules
        key: node-modules-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('.nvmrc', '.npmrc', 'package.json', 'package-lock.json') }}

    # Install scripts stay off: nothing in CI needs them (the allowScripts list in
    # package.json denies `gl`, the only native module without a prebuild for
    # Node 24, and the rest ship their binaries as optional platform packages).
    # No scripts also means no compiler toolchain or X11 headers on the runner.
    - name: Install dependencies
      if: steps.node-modules.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      shell: bash
      run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund

    # Saved right after the install, so the cache holds the pristine tree and not
    # whatever the job writes into node_modules/.cache later on.
    - name: Save node_modules
      if: steps.node-modules.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      uses: actions/cache/save@v6
      with:
        path: node_modules
        key: ${{ steps.node-modules.outputs.cache-primary-key }}

    - name: Cache Playwright binaries
      id: cache-playwright-binary
      if: inputs.browser == 'true'
      uses: actions/cache@v6
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
        key: playwright-binary-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}

    - name: Install Playwright browsers (only if needed)
      if: inputs.browser == 'true' && steps.cache-playwright-binary.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      shell: bash
      run: |
        sudo npx playwright install --with-deps

name: Claude Code

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    types: [opened, assigned]
  pull_request_review:
    types: [submitted]

jobs:
  claude:
    if: |
      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && contains(github.event.comment.body, '@claude')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request_review_comment' && contains(github.event.comment.body, '@claude')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request_review' && contains(github.event.review.body, '@claude')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' && (contains(github.event.issue.body, '@claude') || contains(github.event.issue.title, '@claude')))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read
      id-token: write
      actions: read # Required for Claude to read CI results on PRs
    env:
      # The commit hooks would run lint-staged on Claude's commits; it formats itself instead.
      HUSKY: 0
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      # Without node_modules nx cannot run, so Claude could neither format, lint nor test.
      # This installs from the default branch's lockfile; a PR that changes it runs `npm ci` again.
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/install-deps

      - name: Run Claude Code
        id: claude
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}

          # Lets Claude read CI results on PRs
          additional_permissions: |
            actions: read

          # Bash is off by default: allow what CLAUDE.md asks for before a commit (format, lint, test)
          # and what is needed to follow it. On a PR the action restores `.claude/`, `CLAUDE.md` and
          # `.husky/` from the base branch for security, so those show up as local changes.
          claude_args: |
            --allowedTools "Bash(npx nx *),Bash(npm exec nx *),Bash(npm ci *),Bash(git status*),Bash(git diff*),Bash(git log*),Bash(git add *),Bash(git commit *),Bash(git push*),Bash(gh pr *),Bash(gh run *)"
            --append-system-prompt "On pull requests the action restores .claude/, .mcp.json, CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md and .husky/ from the base branch before you start, so they differ from the PR head in the working tree. That is expected: never commit, revert or format those paths, and stage only the files you changed yourself (git add <paths>, never git add -A). node_modules is installed from the default branch's lockfile; run npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund if the PR changes package-lock.json."

content.text:
I fixed the formatting on PR #2755 and changed the Claude workflows. Both commits are pushed: `e455d270` formats the files, and `9dd58fc8` changes the workflows and the cockpit hooks. CI hasn't run on them yet. Locally, `nx format:check` passes.

**Formatting:** I ran `nx format:write` on the 7 files the CI check flagged (the cockpit hooks, `SKILL.md` and `roles/free-task.md`).

**Why the `@claude` run failed and what I changed:**
- **No `node_modules` on the runner,** so `nx` couldn't run. `claude.yml` now installs dependencies with the repo's own `install-deps` action first.
- **Bash is off by default in the action.** I allowed the commands CLAUDE.md asks for: `npx nx`, `npm ci`, the `git` commands for status, diff, add, commit and push, and `gh pr` / `gh run`.
- **The "uncommitted changes" it saw were expected.** On a PR, the action replaces `.claude/`, `CLAUDE.md` and `.husky/` with the base branch's versions for security, which looks like local changes. Claude's instructions in `claude.yml` now explain this and tell it never to commit those paths.
- **Commit hooks:** `HUSKY: 0` is set so the commit hooks don't run on Claude's commits. The review workflow only moved from `actions/checkout@v4` to `@v7`, like the other workflows.

**Cockpit hooks:** You picked both "keep out of Actions" and "report Actions runs", which conflict. I did the first: the hooks now do nothing when `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true`. Reporting would need the routine's network secret on the runner, and the hooks have no way to send it yet. That would be a separate change if you want it.

The workflow change only takes effect for `@claude` comments after this PR is merged. To see the formatting fix land, check CI on `9dd58fc8`.
